title: Jamaican Sweet Potato Pudding
hookLine: Jamaican-inspired jamaican sweet potato pudding with 15 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Preheat & Prep Your Pan
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and line a 9-inch round pan or loaf pan with parchment paper. Keep {m53344_1}, {m53344_2}, {m53344_3}, and {m53344_4} prepped and measured within reach so each step comes together smoothly and evenly.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure sweet potatoes first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Fold In Flavorings & Mix-Ins
steps.instructionTemplate: Place your cut sweet potatoes in the bowl of a food processor and process until finely grated. In a small bowl, toss raisins in 2 teaspoons flour from the ½ cup. Set aside. Incorporate {m53344_5}, {m53344_6}, {m53344_7}, {m53344_8}, {m53344_9}, {m53344_10}, {m53344_11}, {m53344_12}, {m53344_13}, {m53344_14}, and {m53344_15} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Portion, Shape & Layer Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: In a large bowl, combine grated sweet potatoes, light brown sugar, all-purpose flour, vanilla extract, allspice, cinnamon, nutmeg, ginger, and salt. Stir in 1½ cups of coconut milk until a batter forms. Fold in the raisins that were tossed in the flour.

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour the batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top. Bake uncovered for 1 hour 30 minutes, until mostly set but still slightly soft in the center.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Press plastic wrap directly onto the warm custard surface while chilling to prevent a skin from forming.
